cyclic_symmetric_subcase.contradiction: global inversion would require F(-1)=-F(1)=0, contradicting F(-1)=-1.

interpretation: The Stage-W-REISSUE2 Q,p>1 inversion failure was not merely Q-specific: in the cyclic Stage-X unit-step subcase, global coordinate inversion is structurally impossible with the hard first step.

minimal_control.reason: In the unrestricted three-function general solution, global inversion is equivalent to F,G,H each being odd. Infinitely many odd staircase functions satisfy G(1)=-1 and H(1)=0.

reflection_note: The no-go already follows before adding u-ray reflection; reflection is therefore not the source of the contradiction.
